page.content:
Raw versus Nitro ratings war that forced the Attitude Era.

How Monday Night Wars connects

  • Work: Monday Night Raw — The Monday Night Wars were fought on Raw against WCW Nitro.
  • Concept: Attitude Era — Losing early Monday Night Wars nights pushed WWE into the Attitude Era.

What is Monday Night Wars?

The Monday Night Wars of 1995–2001 pitted Raw against WCW Monday Nitro. WWE answered with Austin, DX, and edgier television until it bought WCW in 2001.

Key threads lead to Monday Night Raw and Attitude Era.
